components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 每个任务状态中唯一的钴蓝主动作。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: min(100%, 390px); min-height: 82px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding: 18px 30px; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1267eb, #0755d4); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(7, 91, 229, 0.17); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(21px, 2vw, 27px); font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), box-shadow 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(7, 91, 229, 0.23); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #075be5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.975); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: 用于重置、返回或补充动作的白色次按钮。
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 56px; padding: 13px 22px; color: #414a55; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dbe0); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), box-shadow 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #aeb8c4; background: #fafbfd; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #075be5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.975); }

components.name: Active Task Choice
components.description: 以钴蓝选中态明确当前文件任务。
components.css: .ds-task-choice { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 152px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 22px 26px; color: #fff; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 11px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1169ec, #0756d7 74%); box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(7, 91, 229, 0.13); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-task-choice::after { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -12px; width: 24px; height: 12px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%); background: var(--blue-deep, #064ec5); content: ""; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-task-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; color: var(--blue, #075be5); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; } .ds-task-icon svg { width: 35px; height: 35px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-task-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-task-copy strong, .ds-task-copy span { display: block; } .ds-task-copy strong { margin-bottom: 7px; font-size: clamp(22px, 2vw, 29px); line-height: 1.24; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-task-copy span { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-task-choice:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(7, 91, 229, 0.18); } .ds-task-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #075be5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-task-choice:active { transform: scale(0.975); }

components.name: Evidence Trigger
components.description: 在主流程旁按需打开安全证据。
components.css: .ds-evidence-trigger { width: min(100%, 555px); min-height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 14px 20px; color: #303741; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #cbd1d8; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-evidence-summary, .ds-evidence-action { display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-evidence-summary { min-width: 0; gap: 11px; } .ds-evidence-summary svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: currentColor; color: var(--green, #167d49); } .ds-evidence-summary strong { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-evidence-action { flex: 0 0 auto; gap: 5px; color: var(--blue, #075be5); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-evidence-action svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-evidence-trigger:hover { border-color: #aeb8c4; background: #fafbfd; } .ds-evidence-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #075be5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-evidence-trigger:active { transform: scale(0.975); }

components.name: Selected File Card
components.description: 展示文件类型、名称、元数据与移除动作。
components.css: .ds-file-card { width: 100%; min-height: 116px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; padding: 20px 22px; color: var(--ink, #171b22); text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dbe0); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(18, 28, 45, 0.035); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-file-icon { width: 74px; height: 74px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: currentColor; color: #16834b; } .ds-file-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-file-copy strong, .ds-file-copy small { display: block; } .ds-file-copy strong { overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: clamp(20px, 2vw, 27px); font-weight: 620; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-file-copy small { color: var(--muted, #626b78); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-file-remove { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; padding: 0; color: #6f7883; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-file-remove svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-file-remove:hover { color: #252c35; background: #f0f2f4; } .ds-file-remove:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #075be5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-file-remove:active { transform: scale(0.975); }

components.name: Prototype Chip
components.description: 只说明当前工件性质的低调标签。
components.css: .ds-prototype-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 5px 9px; color: #525d69; border: 1px solid #d8dde4; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Pending Evidence Summary
components.description: 证据尚待处理时使用的信息蓝摘要。
components.css: .ds-drawer-summary { min-height: 78px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 15px 18px; color: var(--blue, #075be5); border: 1px solid #c8d8ef; border-radius: 9px; background: #f2f6fc; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-drawer-summary svg { width: 29px; height: 29px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: currentColor; } .ds-drawer-summary strong, .ds-drawer-summary small { display: block; } .ds-drawer-summary strong { margin-bottom: 4px; color: currentColor; font-size: 16px; } .ds-drawer-summary small { color: #67716d; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-mapping-table { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #171b22); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dbe0); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-mapping-head, .ds-mapping-row { display: grid; align-items: center; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px minmax(0, 1fr); text-align: center; } .ds-mapping-head { min-height: 42px; color: #4e5964; background: #f5f7f9; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 720; } .ds-mapping-head > span:last-child { color: var(--green, #167d49); } .ds-mapping-row { min-height: 53px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft, #e8eaed); font-size: 13px; } .ds-mapping-head > span, .ds-mapping-row > span { min-width: 0; padding: 0 8px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mapping-row > span:last-child { margin: 6px 9px; padding: 6px 8px; color: #1b633c; border: 1px solid #d3e4d8; border-radius: 6px; background: #f4faf5; font-weight: 680; } .ds-mapping-row svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; justify-self: center; fill: currentColor; color: #77818b; }

components.name: Protection Item Editor
components.description: 在安全详情中补充自动识别之外的保护内容，按文件类型切换为列选择或准确文本输入。
components.html: 选择需要保护的列
components.css: .ds-protection-editor { padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #c8d8ef; border-radius: 8px; background: #f6f9fd; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-protection-editor label { min-height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin: 9px 0 14px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #8fb2e8; border-radius: 7px; background: #f4f8ff; } .ds-protection-editor button { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 15px; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #075be5; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
“可信文件通道”把企业内敏感文件的出入处理成一条可见、可复核、低负担的操作路径。界面采用高频内部工具的 Operate 模式：默认只呈现两项任务、当前文件和唯一主动作，证据与自定义保护按需在同一个抽屉展开，不把使用者置于复杂安全后台中。

视觉以暖白纸面和炭黑文本建立安静的文档感，钴蓝只推动关键动作，墨绿只标记已验证结果；细边框承担大部分分层，阴影只提示结构或交互状态。桌面保留主工作区与证据抽屉的并列关系，窄屏将抽屉转为受控模态层。拒绝营销式 AIDA、滚动叙事、复杂仪表盘和夸张动效。
keyCharacteristics: 高频、低学习成本的企业内部工具
默认简单视图，证据按需展开
暖白纸面、钴蓝主动作、墨绿核验和克制边框
状态同时由图标、文字和颜色表达

rules.name: The Cobalt Is Action Rule
rules.body: 钴蓝推动任务，不能被大面积铺成装饰背景；例外仅限当前任务卡这一明确选中态。

rules.name: The Status Meaning Rule
rules.body: 钴蓝推动、墨绿核验、琥珀拦截；三者不得互换，也不得只靠颜色传达状态。

rules.name: The Workhorse Type Rule
rules.body: 所有文字先服务扫描和操作；不用展示型字体、超大口号或营销式字级跳跃制造气氛。

rules.name: The One Task Focus Rule
rules.body: 每个状态只保留一个视觉主动作；安全证据可以靠近主流程，但必须作为按需检查层而非第二工作台。

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: 阴影必须说明选中、边缘层级或临时反馈；普通卡片不得用浓重悬浮阴影制造后台面板感。

rules.name: The Rectangles Stay Rectangular Rule
rules.body: 主要控件保持克制圆角，不把按钮、卡片和状态条全部胶囊化；圆形只承担图标和步骤语义。

dos: Do show one explicit primary action per task state and keep evidence subordinate.
Do pair every status color with an icon and plain-language text.
Do preserve the warm-paper base, cobalt action, green verification and hairline structure.
Do turn the evidence drawer into a focus-contained overlay at the implemented narrow breakpoint.
Do keep motion brief, state-driven and fully reduced by the existing reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn this into a complex security backend, metric dashboard or administration console.
Don't use marketing AIDA, scroll storytelling, oversized slogans or decorative motion.
Don't make pills the default silhouette or add heavy shadows to ordinary surfaces.
Don't use green as a primary action, cobalt as a verification result or amber as decoration.
Don't hide unresolved states or imply trust through color alone.
